description: This file defines a Java class TenantIdRequestInterceptor that implements the RequestInterceptor interface from Feign. Its purpose is to add tenant ID and default headers to outgoing HTTP requests for multi-tenant support in the Fineract client.

classes.name: TenantIdRequestInterceptor
classes.description: A request interceptor that adds tenant ID and default headers to Feign HTTP requests.

methods.name: TenantIdRequestInterceptor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the interceptor with the tenant ID.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Overrides the apply method to add tenant ID and default headers to the request template.
